concepts.title: Introduction to Node.js
concepts.description: Learn what Node.js is and how to run JavaScript on the server

teachingContent.beginner:
**Node.js** lets you run JavaScript outside the browser - on servers!

**What is Node.js?**
- JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine
- Runs on servers, not browsers
- Perfect for building APIs and web servers

**Running a Node File:**
```bash
# Create a file: app.js
console.log('Hello from Node!');

# Run it:
node app.js
```

**Node REPL:**
```bash
# Start REPL
node

> 2 + 2
4
> console.log('Hello')
Hello
```
